title: No Golden Apples
description: This mod removes all golden apples from Minecraft, so you can’t craft them, find them, or use their healing effects. It takes away one of the strongest survival items in the game.
body: No Golden Apples deletes both normal golden apples and enchanted golden apples from the game. Crafting recipes are removed, chest loot won’t generate them, and you can’t get them from any structure. Without golden apples, players lose instant healing, absorption hearts, and a powerful backup item for PvP, boss fights, or hardcore runs. It makes dangerous situations riskier and forces players to rely on potions or natural regeneration instead.
